transaction_model.transaction_invariant: Full AccountId + SessionId + ConnectionId + Revision + ExpiresAt + selected owned role + ban + current Encounter/Actor generation must be checked at the authoritative mutation boundary; background objective worker requires separately explicit fenced Server-owned processing lease, never blind Client trust
